div.head: ECf 32 B 1
div.ab: Isti uero uiri eligebantur per commune consilium pro communi utilitate regni, per prouincias et patrias uniuersas et per singulos comitatus in pleno folkesmot, sicut et uicecomites prouinciarum et comitatuum eligi debent, ita quod in quolibet comitatu semper fuit unus heretoch per electionem electus, ad conducendum exercitum comitatus sui iuxta preceptum domini regis, ad honorem et ad utilitatem corone regni predicti, semper cum opus adfuerit in regno.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 656 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints across the page as an insertion into ECf retr. 32 (32 A–E, pp. 655–660). The dictionary cites it as “ECf 32 A …”, so it is kept with ECf here.

note.seg: schwerlich aus Bæda Hist. eccl. V 10, sondern erfunden, wie das Folgende über Sheriffswahl, was Verf. aus Londoner Vorrecht (vgl. Hn Lond 1) verallgemeinert oder zur Beschränkung der Krone nur ersehnt; diese gewährte erst 1258/59 zeitweise die Sheriffswahl

hardly from Bede, Hist. eccl. V 10, but invented, like what follows on the election of sheriffs, which the author generalizes from a London privilege (cf. Hn Lond 1) or merely longs for as a limit on the Crown; the Crown only granted the election of sheriffs, for a time, in 1258/59
vgl. S. 657d; dass der Angelsächs. Shire regelmässig ein Ealdorman vorstand, weiss Verf. auch sonst nicht
cf. p. 657, note d; elsewhere too the author does not know that an ealdorman regularly presided over the Anglo-Saxon shire
